and-field event there this weekend. | don’t know about the

time for the event. Now, ®in case of rain, you won't be let
with nothing to do. The summer art fair is taking place at
the park’s convention center. The organizing committee
recommends checking the Ray Mountain Park’s Web site
Friday morning to get the latest information.
